# AgentWorks

AgentWorks makes a team faster by letting everyone's AI agents work together. Everyone on a team has AI, but each person's AI works alone and the work between people still moves by hand: someone passes it on, explains it again, chases it and asks where it stands. With AgentWorks anyone can hand work to an agent, agents pass it on to each other and to people (across teams, laptops and the server, through AgentBridge), and everyone sees who, person or agent, is on what. How it works: Ask (anyone asks the team's agents for data, status or a draft, from the app, Slack, WhatsApp or their own AI tool), Hand off (agents pass work on; a person is asked only when the decision is theirs), Keep it running (agents stay online and run routine work on a schedule). It is for every team: sales, support, finance, marketing, operations, product and engineering. Nothing to replace: companies keep Jira, Notion, Google Docs and Sheets, Slack and their other tools; agents work inside them, and the Team kit shares tool connections (MCPs), secrets and skills across teams and projects. Each person uses the AI plan they already pay for (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor and others). It runs on the company's own server or a Mac, and people approve anything that goes out. How a company starts: we set it up with one team in four weeks on their servers (one piece of work they pass around by hand, the tools connected, the agents built with their people), then their team runs it under a commercial licence. The source is public under the Business Source License 1.1.

## Canonical Pages

- [Homepage](https://agentworkshq.com/): Everyone on your team has AI; AgentWorks makes the team faster. Examples (sales account review, support complaint, product bug), how it works (ask, hand off, keep it running), every team, keep your tools, your own AI plans, your servers, and the four-week setup with one team.
- [How it works](https://agentworkshq.com/platform/): ask, hand off, keep it running; one team room where the Team panel shows who (person or agent) is on what; AgentBridge, the Team kit (shared tool connections, secrets and skills), Brain and Vault; keep your tools, bring your own AI plan, runs on your servers, people approve what goes out. An illustrative QA-to-developer hand-off.
  - [AgentBridge](https://agentworkshq.com/agentbridge/): connects the agents a team already runs in its own CLIs and desktop apps (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Muse Code, Antigravity) into one network; they find each other, hand work over and ask the team's online agents over MCP; one agent can act as orchestrator. Attaching is always the person's choice, and a message is an offer until the receiving agent acknowledges it.
  - [Brain](https://agentworkshq.com/brain/): one shared place for the company's skills, notes and facts, in nested folders with Reader, Editor and Owner roles; read and written by the team's agents and any MCP client such as Claude Code; version history with rollback, optional Git backup, and a /organize command that merges duplicates. Text search only.
  - [Vault](https://agentworkshq.com/vault/): one place for the tools and shared keys a team's agents use; admins connect tools (MCP servers) once, give access by group (off by default), add rules on tool inputs, review new or changed tools, sign in with the company account, and keep a record of every call. Agents receive a shared key at run time; Vault stops keys being pasted around and used outside the group.
- [Premade agents](https://agentworkshq.com/agents/): 79 premade agents with public source for sales, marketing, support, finance, Shopify, operations, product and engineering, each a starting point adapted during setup. Each links to its source in the agentworks repo.
  - [GTM Ops](https://agentworkshq.com/solutions/sales/): lead research, fast follow-up and pipeline questions answered for the whole team.
  - [Shopify Ops](https://agentworkshq.com/solutions/shopify/): stuck orders, customer questions, returns and failed payments.
  - [Customer support](https://agentworkshq.com/solutions/support/): fast first replies from docs and order history, sensitive cases handed to a person.
  - [Finance & billing](https://agentworkshq.com/solutions/finance/): invoice chasing, failed-payment recovery and a weekly business report.
  - [Marketing & growth](https://agentworkshq.com/solutions/marketing/): SEO, AI-search visibility and competitor watch.
  - [Growth & Customer Analytics](https://agentworkshq.com/solutions/growth/): why a number moved, with the evidence, handed to whoever owns the fix.
  - [Engineering Ops](https://agentworkshq.com/solutions/engineering/): release checks, incident first look, security findings and cloud cost; QA hands bugs to the developer's agent, engineers approve.
- [How we work](https://agentworkshq.com/pricing/): in four weeks we set AgentWorks up with one team on the company's servers (one piece of work they pass around by hand, the tools connected, the agents built with their people), then their team runs it; a fixed setup, then the product licence, agreed on a call. No prices published, no free tier, no hosted plan.
- [Connect your AI app](https://agentworkshq.com/docs/guides/connect-agentbridge/): Local Codex setup does not add ChatGPT/Dot tools. Muse Code needs its own reviewed plugin; the Muse app is separate. Grok Bot and Muse personal-agent app setup follows each provider's hosted connector flow; live AgentWorks testing is pending.
- [Harness engineering](https://agentworkshq.com/harness-engineering/): an AI agent is a model plus a harness (instructions and context, tools, the work loop, guardrails, checks and records). AgentWorks is the shared agent harness for a company, built around the Claude Code, Codex and Cursor agents its people already use; each harness part mapped to where it lives in the product.
- [Blog](https://agentworkshq.com/blog/): image-first explainers and guides on running a company with AI agents ([RSS](https://agentworkshq.com/blog/feed.xml)). First post: [Harness engineering, explained](https://agentworkshq.com/blog/harness-engineering-explained/).
- [Download](https://agentworkshq.com/download/): install the desktop app on an Apple Silicon Mac with `curl -fsSL https://agentworkshq.com/install.sh | bash`, or run it on a Linux server.
- [About](https://agentworkshq.com/about/): AgentWorks is a product of XTECH, a partnership firm in India founded in December 2025; founder Manish Prakash; source-available (Business Source License 1.1), set up with companies under a commercial licence.
- [Docs](https://agentworkshq.com/docs/): plain-language guides.
  - [Talk to your agents in Slack](https://agentworkshq.com/docs/guides/slack/): mentions, threads and approvals from Slack.
  - [Talk to your agents on WhatsApp](https://agentworkshq.com/docs/guides/whatsapp/): QR pairing, status and approvals from chat.
  - [Share secrets safely](https://agentworkshq.com/docs/guides/share-secrets/): one key in Vault that the team's agents can use, without pasting it around.
  - [Developer docs on GitHub](https://github.com/manishiitg/agentworks/tree/main/docs): install, architecture, MCP, security, self-hosting.

## Key Concepts

- Team: the people who work together and their AI agents, in one shared project on the company's server. The Team panel shows who, person or agent, is on what.
- Ask, Hand off, Keep it running: anyone asks the team's agents; agents pass work to each other and to people (a person is asked only when the decision is theirs); agents stay online and run routine work on a schedule.
- AgentBridge: agents message each other and hand over work, across people, laptops and the server.
- Team kit: tool connections (MCPs), secrets and skills set up once and shared across teams and projects.
- Brain: company knowledge and skills for every agent. Vault: secrets and tool access, and who may use them.
- Nothing to replace: Jira, Notion, Google Docs and Sheets, Slack and the rest stay; agents work inside them.
- Bring your own AI: each person uses the plan they already pay for (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor and others) through each vendor's own agent.
